median_hidden_norm.representation: canonical selected transformer-block output at the last prefill token of the Yes/No judgment prompt
median_hidden_norm.population: held-out intervention samples; false and true representations pooled before one median
median_hidden_norm.aggregation: all seed rows pooled (5x200/side for 7--8B; 3x200/side for 14B); duplicate IDs retained when sampled by different seeds

dose.matched_achieved_r: exactly 0.100000 by frozen construction (stored float division may display binary rounding)

endpoint_and_delta_m.m: Yes-minus-No next-token raw-logit margin, using the maximum-logit candidate independently within each five-token Yes and No candidate set
endpoint_and_delta_m.candidate_changes: candidate identity is recomputed per forward pass and may change; stored artifacts include winning token IDs
endpoint_and_delta_m.aggregation: sample-level paired (intervention minus baseline) differences -> item mean within seed -> unweighted mean across seeds

protocol.paired_ids: fixed and matched each use the same 200 IDs as their corresponding baselines
protocol.system_prompt: Explicit 'You are a helpful assistant.' in all matched-r runs and all fixed-alpha source runs except legacy Mistral-7B TriviaQA E8, where the frozen protocol explicitly omitted it.
protocol.matched_baseline: TriviaQA E12 reran/stored baseline; ARC/CSQA E12-2 explicitly reused exact E9-2 frozen baseline artifacts.
